Staging membership is derived from the exact tracked Git object/manifest authority for the selected commit, not wholesale live workspace copies.
Inventory rejects environment files, private keys, credential/token files, and equivalent case/path variants with an exact stable reason code and PACKAGING_INVENTORY layer.
A normal Windows artifact builds and its inventory equals the admitted tracked roster.
Packaging and release supply-chain tests run standalone with nonzero counts.
